source.paraphrase: The composition root must own setup before runtime access and must apply one reviewed configuration. A second setup call must not be used to change a running configuration. A system factory must not use normal dependency gates through the bootstrap placeholder.

invariants.why: The composition root must own setup before runtime access and must apply one reviewed configuration. A second setup call must not be used to change a running configuration. A system factory must not use normal dependency gates through the bootstrap placeholder. The product initializes dcouplr or supplies a system factory.
invariants.fixHint: Exercise the actual first setup, access before setup and attempted reconfiguration. Assert the effective configuration and system-factory bootstrap dependencies. The pinned setup ignores later calls; early system factories receive a placeholder whose dependency operations reject access. Inspector readiness is a separate asynchronous boundary. Bind DCP-FACTORY-RUNTIME-001 to a human-reviewed project assertion with explicit applicability, owner, actual application inputs and freshness. Include a failing control. Run pregate fitness run DCP-FACTORY-RUNTIME-001.
invariants.avoid: Project evidence gate, not a syntax detector or complete library certification. Source canaries verify the upstream contrast, not consumer compliance. Receipt fixtures verify evidence admission only. No executable command is supplied by this pack. Missing bindings remain UNVERIFIED; an adopted enforcing binding blocks stale or failed evidence, while shadow stays diagnostic. Conditional non-use requires an explicit reviewed reason and evidence, not an unexplained success.

source.paraphrase: Factory input admission must enforce the actual domain constraints before the creator runs. A mandatory shape is not proof of strict input types, own-property membership or an immutable validation contract. Shared input and shape mutation must have an explicit owner.

invariants.why: Factory input admission must enforce the actual domain constraints before the creator runs. A mandatory shape is not proof of strict input types, own-property membership or an immutable validation contract. Shared input and shape mutation must have an explicit owner. A factory accepts untrusted input, a mandatory shape or singleton creation parameters.
invariants.fixHint: Reject invalid domain values and assert that rejected input never reaches the creator. Test coercion-compatible values and inherited properties at the real boundary. Freeze or own the shape and nested parameters: the pinned shape is retained by reference, the input is not copied, and singleton parameters receive only a shallow copy. A configured system factory must satisfy the actual contract used by its consumers, not only callable-member admission.

source.paraphrase: A dependency owner must choose transient or singleton lifetime and must verify the resulting identity, shared mutation and scope. A singleton must not hold one user's or organization's mutable state for unrelated callers. Resolution failure must have an owned retry and effect policy.

invariants.why: A dependency owner must choose transient or singleton lifetime and must verify the resulting identity, shared mutation and scope. A singleton must not hold one user's or organization's mutable state for unrelated callers. Resolution failure must have an owned retry and effect policy. A dependency is resolved repeatedly, shared across requests or materialized as a singleton.
